hooks.command: bash -c 'for p in hooks/dispatch.sh .agents/hooks/dispatch.sh; do [ -f "$p" ] && exec bash "$p" "$@"; done' -- pre-tool-use
bash -c 'for p in hooks/dispatch.sh .agents/hooks/dispatch.sh; do [ -f "$p" ] && exec bash "$p" "$@"; done' -- post-tool-use

Stop.command: bash -c 'for p in hooks/dispatch.sh .agents/hooks/dispatch.sh; do [ -f "$p" ] && exec bash "$p" "$@"; done' -- stop
